svg.title: Core systems — CortexAgent, MigrationLens, NeuroShield and FairLend
CortexAgent — Multi-Agent Rag
svg.desc: Four LangGraph agents answer SEC 10-K research questions, cite filing chunks and pass every draft through a critic before it is returned. Evidence: 20/20 prompts passed in the documented single-model behavioral-contract baseline, not the full orchestrator.

svg.title: MigrationLens — Sql Migration Risk
svg.desc: Finds application code that still depends on MySQL-only behaviour before a PostgreSQL cutover; deterministic rules first, every fix validated. Evidence: 37/37 expected findings on the documented Sakila fixture, not general accuracy.

svg.title: NeuroShield — Graph Ml · Aml
svg.desc: Scores risky Bitcoin transactions on the Elliptic graph, explains each decision and drafts SAR narratives grounded only in validated evidence. GraphSAGE PR-AUC 0.5177 on Elliptic timesteps 40-49 (11,184 labelled nodes).

svg.title: FairLend — Responsible Ai
svg.desc: Measures proxy discrimination in mortgage credit decisions, constrains it with Fairlearn and explains each applicant's outcome with SHAP. Rounded DPR 0.903 for the mitigated model in the documented HMDA research benchmark; not the synthetic demo or a legal certification.
